question: Pull Skechers' latest 10-Q and give me net sales and earnings from operations for its quarter ended June 30, 2026, in USD millions.
grading: Must state that no Skechers 10-Q exists for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 because Skechers was taken private (merger closed Sept 12, 2025; Form 15 deregistration filed Sept 23, 2025), so SEC-filed net sales and earnings from operations are unavailable. May cite the last filed quarter (June 30, 2025: net sales USD 2,440.0M; earnings from operations USD 173.1M) clearly labelled as 2025. Fail if any 2026 net sales or operating earnings figure is presented as filed.
answer: There is no such filing. Skechers was acquired by 3G Capital (merger completed September 12, 2025; NYSE delisting) and filed a Form 15 on September 23, 2025 terminating its SEC reporting duties, with one holder of record [H16-E1][H16-E2]. Its last periodic reports on EDGAR are the 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 (filed August 8, 2025: net sales USD 2,440.0 million; earnings from operations USD 173.1 million) and the FY2024 10-K (filed February 28, 2025); there is no 10-K for 2025 and no 10-Q for 2026 [H16-E3][H16-E4].

output.answer:
## Short answer

**There is no Skechers 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 — and there never will be.** Skechers was taken private and stopped filing quarterly reports with the SEC in 2025.

**What happened:** On May 4, 2025, Skechers agreed to be acquired by 3G Capital (via Beach Acquisition Co Parent, LLC) for $63.00/share in cash (or $57.00 cash + one equity unit of the new private parent). The merger closed **September 12, 2025**; Skechers became a private company, its stock was delisted from the NYSE, and it deregistered under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act.

**Consequence:** The last 10-Q Skechers ever filed was for the quarter ended **June 30, 2025** (filed August 8, 2025). As a private company, Skechers no longer files 10-Qs, 10-Ks, or 8-Ks, so no Q2 2026 financial statements exist in SEC EDGAR.

## Using the actual most recent 10-Q (quarter ended June 30, 2025)

From the Consolidated Statements of Earnings in the 10-Q (in thousands, converted to USD millions):

| Metric | Q2 2025 | Q2 2024 |
|---|---|---|
| Net sales | **$2,440.0M** ($2,440,024) | $2,157.6M |
| Earnings from operations | **$173.1M** ($173,082) | $206.5M |
| Net earnings | $182.7M | $164.5M |
| Net earnings attributable to Skechers | $170.5M | $140.3M |
| Diluted EPS | $1.13 | $0.91 |

Source: [Skechers 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 (SEC EDGAR)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065837/000095017025105871/skx-20250630.htm); see also the [Q2 2025 earnings release, Exhibit 99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1065837/000095017025105856/skx-ex99_1.htm).

## Two clarifications worth flagging

1. **Ticker caution:** A search result labeled `syk10q3312026.pdf` (net sales $6,020M, net earnings $745M) is **Stryker Corporation (SYK)**, a medical device company — not Skechers (SKX). It is not Skechers data.
2. **"Earnings from operations"** is Skechers' line-item label in its income statement (equivalent to operating income); the figures above are the unadjusted GAAP numbers.

If you actually need Q2 2026 figures, they would only be available through the private company's own disclosures/lender reporting (e.g., to the Greenberg family and 3G Capital), not via a public SEC filing.
